claude.summary: Make complex thoughts clear, and good writing better.
claude.description: A thoughtful partner for reading documents, organizing ideas, and finding the right words.
claude.feature3: Organize ideas and work with code
claude.prompt: Write a friendly invitation to a community AI workshop. Keep it simple and make the schedule and things to bring easy to find.

chatgpt.summary: From everyday questions to your next big idea.
chatgpt.description: Talk through your questions, explore ideas, and get a little help with writing, learning, and everyday life.
chatgpt.feature3: Plan your learning and everyday tasks
chatgpt.prompt: Suggest five practical ways a beginner can use AI. Add a simple everyday example for each one.

gemini.summary: Bring a wider perspective to everyday questions.
gemini.description: Google's AI helps you explore ideas, ask questions about text and images, and put information together.
gemini.prompt: Suggest indoor activities for a rainy weekend in Jeju with older family members. Prioritize places that are comfortable to visit.

grok.summary: A fresh perspective, just a conversation away.
grok.description: Explore different viewpoints and expand your thinking through a conversation about the things that interest you.
grok.feature1: Talk about a range of topics
grok.prompt: Suggest five fun activities for a smartphone class for older adults. Make them hands-on and easy to join.

perplexity.summary: Search, understand, and follow the sources.
perplexity.description: Ask a question, explore an answer, and check the linked sources to learn more.
perplexity.prompt: Explain what Jeju's Gotjawal forests are and why they matter. Include sources I can read to learn more.

genspark.summary: Turn scattered information into something useful.
genspark.description: Organize research and develop ideas for documents and presentations.
genspark.prompt: Create a plan for a four-week community AI course. Include learning goals and a practical activity for each week.

notebooklm.summary: A research partner that knows your materials.
notebooklm.description: Ask questions about the sources you add, organize their key ideas, and build a deeper understanding.
notebooklm.prompt: Summarize the five key ideas in these materials. Use plain language that a first-time reader can understand.

flow.summary: Turn the scene in your mind into a moving story.
flow.description: Explore visual ideas, create scenes, and bring your imagination into motion.
flow.prompt: A peaceful Jeju beach at sunset, silver grass swaying slowly in the breeze, gentle waves. A warm, cinematic moment.

suno.summary: Let a little imagination become your own music.
suno.description: Describe a mood and a topic to start creating a song. No musical experience needed.
suno.prompt: A bright acoustic song about walking by the sea in Jeju. Soft guitar, warm vocals, and lyrics about simple moments with friends.
